Seeed Studio XIAO nRF52840 is an ultra-compact, low-power wireless development board powered by the Nordic Semiconductor nRF52840 SoC. It features a 64 MHz Arm Cortex-M4F processor with a floating-point unit, 256 KB of RAM, 1 MB of on-chip Flash, and an additional 2 MB of onboard Flash, providing sufficient processing and storage capacity for wireless, sensing, and embedded applications.
The board supports Bluetooth Low Energy, Bluetooth Mesh, NFC, and 2.4 GHz wireless communication through an onboard antenna. It provides UART, I²C, SPI, ADC, PWM, NFC, and SWD interfaces, together with USB Type-C connectivity and onboard lithium-battery charging management.
With a compact size of only 21 × 17.8 mm, single-sided component placement, and castellated pads, XIAO nRF52840 is suitable for both rapid prototyping and surface-mount integration into custom PCBs.

Seeed Studio XIAO nRF52840 Sense is an ultra-compact, low-power development board that combines wireless connectivity, motion sensing, and audio capture. It is powered by the Nordic Semiconductor nRF52840 SoC, featuring a 64 MHz Arm Cortex-M4F processor, 256 KB of RAM, 1 MB of on-chip Flash, and an additional 2 MB of onboard Flash.
Compared with the standard XIAO nRF52840, the Sense version integrates an LSM6DS3TR-C six-axis IMU and a PDM digital microphone. It can directly capture acceleration, angular velocity, voice, and environmental sound without requiring additional sensor modules.
The board supports Bluetooth Low Energy, Bluetooth Mesh, NFC, and 2.4 GHz wireless communication. With a compact 21 × 17.8 mm form factor, onboard antenna, USB Type-C connector, and lithium-battery charging management, it is well suited for wearable devices, motion recognition, audio sensing, and low-power IoT products.

Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-S3 is a compact, high-performance wireless development board powered by the Espressif ESP32-S3R8 SoC. It features a dual-core 32-bit Xtensa LX7 processor running at up to 240 MHz, together with 8 MB of PSRAM and 8 MB of Flash, providing sufficient processing and memory resources for IoT, wireless control, signal processing, and lightweight edge-AI applications.
The board supports 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, Bluetooth Low Energy 5.0, and Bluetooth Mesh. A U.FL antenna connector and external 2.4 GHz antenna provide reliable wireless connectivity while preserving the compact 21 × 17.8 mm XIAO form factor.
XIAO ESP32-S3 provides UART, I²C, SPI, ADC, PWM, capacitive-touch, and native USB interfaces. It also includes USB Type-C connectivity, lithium-battery charging management, Reset and Boot buttons, and user-programmable status indicators. Its castellated pads and single-sided component layout make it suitable for both rapid prototyping and surface-mount integration into custom PCBs.
